meta.name: ecommerce-copywriter
meta.description: 电商运营与内容创作者在需要为多品类商品创作或优化营销图片文案时使用。自动提炼核心卖点，生成带emoji的吸睛标题与直击痛点的场景化正文，一键产出高转化率电商文案，省时省力大幅提升商品点击与购买转化！

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 提炼商品卖点，生成带表情的吸睛营销文案
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你经常需要为电商商品撰写吸引人的标题和描述
copy.tagline_en: Generate compelling product copy from key selling points
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often write product titles and descriptions for online stores

howto.what: 装好后,Claude 会为电商商品写图片营销文案:收集产品名称、卖点、目标用户后,按痛点—产品—卖点—情感四段结构,产出带 emoji 的标题与正文,并输出 Markdown;也能优化你已有的文案。
howto.when: 当你提出电商文案创作或优化需求,比如给某款商品写营销图片文案、改标题和正文时,它会接管。

say.text: 帮我给这款智能睡眠眼罩写一段电商图片文案,卖点是科学遮光和智能感应光线
say.note: 它会先问卖点和目标用户,再产出完整文案

say.text: 帮我把这段已有的商品文案改一下标题,加上 emoji 和产品昵称
say.note: 它会改写标题、正文结构和 emoji

say.text: 给这款便携充电宝写文案,目标用户是经常出差的人
say.note: 它会按四段结构输出文案

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude writes e-commerce image copy: it gathers product name, selling points and target users, then outputs an emoji headline and a four-part body in Markdown. It also improves existing titles, body text and emoji.
howto.when_en: Use it when you ask for e-commerce copy to be written or optimized, such as creating image copy for a product or rewriting a title and body text.

say_en.text: Write e-commerce image copy for this sleep mask; key points: light blocking.
say_en.note: It asks for selling points and target users first.

say_en.text: Rewrite the title of this product copy and add emoji and a product nickname.
say_en.note: It reworks the title, body structure and emoji.

say_en.text: Write copy for this power bank; target users are people who travel often.
say_en.note: It writes pain point, product, selling points and emotion.
